title: CE41028: Structural Health Monitoring
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to structural health monitoring. Non destructive techniques (NDT).
Mechanical Strain and Displacement gages. Static . load testing. Accelerometers
and vibration measurement. Vibration based techniques. Sensors : Fiber optic
sensors, piezoelectric sensors, electrical resistance based sensors. Noncontact measurement. Numerical modeling, analysis of structures and inverse
analysis. Comparison of experimental data and structural parameter updating.
